question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: William Wordsworth was born at Cockermouth in England in 1770. He studied at St. John's College. After receiving his Cambridge degree, he moved to France and fell in love with a Frenchwoman, Annette Vallon. He along with Coleridge published 'Lyrical Ballads' in 1798. His largest poem 'The Excursion' was published in 1814. Wordsworth spent the last fifty years of his life at Grasmere and Rydal Mount and many of his sonnets were written in these places. He breathed his last at Rydal Mount in 1850.
